title: Repository intelligence as a derived application view
outcomes: .go connects durable product intent and executable tasks to a current, queryable representation of the repository without becoming a second code source of truth.
Agents receive bounded relevant application context and can verify actual blast radius against declared task scope.

in: Regenerable file, component, symbol, import and test graph
Task-to-node references and bounded execution context
Local blast-radius and architecture drift reporting
out: Hosted indexing services or mandatory model providers
Automatic mutation of architecture intent from observed code
Complete compiler-grade extraction for every language in the first release
boundaries: Source code describes observed implementation; repository-map describes durable semantic identity; architecture briefs and decisions describe intent; tasks describe authorized work.
Generated graph data stays below .go/cache and is never canonical task, decision or architecture state.

decision_rights: curate stable component identity and intended dependencies
choose advisory or strict task impact policy
rebuild and query derived graph data
report observed drift without rewriting accepted intent

constraints: Existing repositories and tasks without repository-intelligence state remain valid.
The index excludes .go itself and cannot recursively ingest workflow state.
No GitHub Actions, hosted service or model call is required for build, query or blast-radius verification.
Direct node references survive regeneration and resolve against committed repository-map state.

quality_attributes.scenario: The same repository bytes and map are indexed twice.
quality_attributes.measure: Byte differences between generated graph payloads after excluding the generated timestamp

quality_attributes.scenario: A task requests repository context for named nodes and queries.
quality_attributes.measure: Selected nodes beyond the declared budget, excluding directly requested mandatory nodes

quality_attributes.scenario: A task diff changes indexed source before finish.
quality_attributes.measure: Changed or transitively impacted nodes omitted from the blast-radius result

risks: Generated topology can become stale or be mistaken for authoritative architecture.
Fine-grained symbol data can create excessive context and Git churn if committed.
Heuristic extraction can miss dynamic dependencies; results must state coverage and freshness rather than claim completeness.
